Clear the cached fitted values of a Bayesian GP fit

Source: R/model-classes.R
clear_fitted_cache.Rd

Removes the cached fitted() values of a bayesian_fit, so the next call recomputes them from the posterior. You need it only after editing the brmsfit engine in place. A change to data_sf, or a refit, invalidates the entry on its own (see "The Bayesian GP cache" in spatial_fit-fitted). On any other fit it does nothing.

Usage

clear_fitted_cache(object)

Arguments

object

A bayesian_fit object.

Value

object, invisibly.

Details

Every copy of a fit shares the cache, so clearing it through one copy clears it for all of them; the others recompute.

See also

Other options and caches: clear_grid_cache(), spatialkit-conditions, spatialkit-options, spatialkit_quiet()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Needs brms and a Stan toolchain, and takes minutes.
library(sf)
set.seed(1)
n <- 60
dat <- st_as_sf(
  data.frame(x = 5e5 + runif(n, 0, 1000), y = 5e6 + runif(n, 0, 1000),
             elev = rnorm(n)),
  coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 32632
)
dat$price <- 10 + 2 * dat$elev + rnorm(n)
fit <- fit_bayesian_spatial_model(dat, "price", "elev", chains = 2,
                                  iter = 1000, compute_loo = FALSE)
f1 <- fitted(fit)          # computed from the posterior and cached
clear_fitted_cache(fit)
f2 <- fitted(fit)          # computed again
all.equal(f1, f2)
} # }
